title: Roamhaven Rewards Member Benefit: Relief on the Guest Service Fee of a Notice Charge
content:
# Roamhaven Rewards member benefit — guest service fee relief on a notice charge

**Benefit term.** Roamhaven Rewards members get relief on the guest service fee of a notice charge on a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category: a guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes a dedicated concierge is relieved of 100 percent of it; a guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes the priority support line but no dedicated concierge is relieved of 50 percent of it; any other guest gets no Rewards relief. The guest service fee of the notice charge is reduced by this relief, and the relief is applied to the fee before it is rounded.

What decides the benefit is the guest's Roamhaven Rewards membership on record: its tier, the features that tier carries, and whether the membership is active.

## Benefit table

| Guest's Roamhaven Rewards membership | Relief on the notice charge's guest service fee |
|---|---|
| active, tier includes a dedicated concierge | 100 percent |
| active, tier includes the priority support line but no dedicated concierge | 50 percent |
| active, tier with neither feature | none |
| not active, or no membership | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical fee of 237.14 before relief)

| Membership | Relief | Fee after relief |
|---|---|---|
| dedicated concierge | 100 percent | 0.00 |
| priority support line only | 50 percent | 118.57 |
| neither | none | 237.14 |
